description: Creates the letter for a quote and returns a payment link (Stripe Checkout). No account is needed. YOU CANNOT PAY: show the price and the payment link to the human and ask them to open it and pay. The letter is mailed right after payment and cannot be cancelled or recalled once paid, so paying is the point of no return: make sure the human has seen the price, the recipient and the document first. Calling it again with the same quote_id returns the same letter and link (or its current status once it has been paid). The link expires after about 24 hours. Optionally pass webhook_url (public https) to be notified of status changes. Poll get_letter_status to follow the letter. Autonomous agents whose owner gave them a card through a Stripe Shared Payment Token (e.g. Link) can pay by card themselves with MPP through the REST API (POST /v1/letters with payment_method "mpp", which may be disabled: 422 payment_method_unavailable). Agents that can sign crypto payments can instead pay with x402 through the REST API (POST /v1/letters with payment_method "x402", which may be disabled on this deployment: 422 payment_method_unavailable); official x402 clients cap a payment at $1 by default, so raise the spend limit to cover the quoted price first.

webhook_url.description: Public https URL notified on each status change
